calibration.readers independent of the text layer (1: MinerU advanced copies the layer on born-digital pages (48 layer / 0 image in text blocks); OXR reads the image (51 / 0)
calibration.character check recall (10-28, 216 plant: in compared text 191 surfaced as disagreements but 3; jev chose the printed side for 182, 0 wrong; headers, footers, page numbers, equations not compared (12). Only errors on the layer side were planted, so this does not measure pages that print a typo
calibration.character judge (10-28, 106 items: 34 pr: Gemini on numbered sheets of tight crops, both option orders: 0 wrong among decided; undecided 9/34, 4/12, 5/60 (undecided items are open issues with their crop). jev and deepseek-flash chose the corrected spelling of printed typos in 25-40% of decided cases and are not used for characters
calibration.jev first for characters (10-29, 31 docu: jev asked per reading whether the crop prints exactly it decided 104; where Gemini (0.3.0) had decided the same item, 84 of 86 agree; the 2 others are printed spellings jev took for the common one ('Interpetation', 'biomedcentral'), so a letters-only difference jev settles against the text layer goes to Gemini
calibration.crops for the character judges (10-30, 3: each crop is checked by jev to show the two words before, the disputed part and the two words after, whole, before any judge sees it; 380 passed (363 at once, 17 after widening or on the side in the same block); the 16 that did not were inspected: 8 symbols the page does not print or text in figures and logos, 3 with their context in another block, 3 crops cut or misplaced, 2 crops that do show the passage (jev wrong). Of 26 crops passed that an earlier, stricter check had refused, 25 show the passage, 1 shows the same words in the next reference entry
calibration.second reader (10-29, 203 planted errors: OXR found 187, MiniCPM-OCR 186, both together 188: one second reader is enough; jev alone on lines (no second reader) rejected 36% of correct lines, so one is needed
calibration.dropped content (10-29, 9 papers): jev on red-box crops 'prints exactly «layer words»': 101 findings labelled on the page, 95 decided, 3 wrong; written only where the primary's own characters around place it (49 written, checked on crops; one wrong, a fraction's denominator written into the next line, led to the same-line rule)
calibration.inline formulas (10-29, 31 documents): MinerU reads inline $...$ from the image even on born-digital pages: 30 misread formulas ('pm' for 'µm', 'ANN' for 'ANC', 'M×ED' for 'MIXED', 'I56' for '156', 'X^2' for a printed 'χ2') retyped from the layer with raised and lowered glyphs as <sup>/<sub>, only where every difference inside is a printed finding; doubtful ones checked on the page, all right. Stacked scripts, fractions and roots are not retyped
calibration.reading order (10-29, 9 papers, about 12: block order wrong at 2 places, both at figures (a caption split over two columns; body text typed as a figure note); sentences cut by page or column breaks, with floats between, joined by jev: of 240 joins in 31 documents the 44 with an upper-case continuation all right, 25 sampled lower-case ones all right; one wrong join (a heading typed as text) led to the rule that only a paragraph skips blocks
calibration.OXR (10-28): OXR itself corrects about half of printed letter typos and turns middle dots into periods; where both readings agree on a corrected form nothing is flagged
calibration.text-layer coverage, equations (10-28, 9: coverage found the dropped italic journal names in page footers (2 papers); 8 display equations all agree with OXR after canonical LaTeX. 10-29, 31 documents: 29 display equations (pathology papers have few), 18 equal OXR, 1 differed by a tag only, 10 figure labels OXR did not read; rendering both readings for a visual judge was not built for so few
calibration.tables (10-29, 87 tables of 31 documents: MinerU's cells aligned to the layer's characters (99.4% in content-stream order); differences were look-alikes (533: ✘ written ×, ✔ ✓, – -, · .), a cell's lines glued (206), 3 misread words ('tisse'); jev took MinerU's 'tisse' for printed, so OXR's table decides first.
